title: Respond calmly to a problem
summary: An incident is an event that may harm security. Stop risky actions, preserve useful facts and get help from the responsible person.
introduction: An incident is an event that may harm security. Stop risky actions, preserve useful facts and get help from the responsible person. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Explain respond calmly to a problem
Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: An incident is an event that may harm security. Stop risky actions, preserve useful facts and get help from the responsible person.

blocks.code:
Unexpected sign-in notice
1. Do not follow the message link
2. Open the service through a known address
3. Review activity and contact its support if needed
blocks.title: Respond calmly to a problem

blocks.text: The steps avoid adding a new risk while checking the warning. A young learner should ask a trusted adult for help.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Write down the time and what you observed without sharing secret codes.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: Do not erase useful evidence or accuse someone before the facts are checked.
For more detail later, use this [Cybersecurity Fundamentals further reading](https://www.cisa.gov/secure-our-world).
